Connect Google Drive

One-time setup for the site owner

  1. In Google Cloud, create a project and enable Google Drive API, Google Sheets API, and Google Picker API. Google API Library
  2. Configure Google Auth Platform with an app name, audience, support email and the scopes openid, email, profile, and https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.file. For public sign-in, choose External under Audience, then Publish app. In Branding, use your deployed home page and its privacy.html URL. Check Verification Center for any required steps.
  3. Create a Web application OAuth client. Set the authorized JavaScript origin to your site origin, such as https://YOUR-NAME.github.io or http://localhost:8000. Keep the repository path out of the origin.
  4. Create a browser API key restricted to Google Picker API and your site’s HTTP referrers. Copy the numeric Google Cloud project number.
  5. In your GitHub repository, open Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → Variables. Set GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_API_KEY and GOOGLE_APP_ID (the project number). Rerun the Pages workflow. For local development, enter the same public values in dist/config.js.

Create and share your household

Connect your Google account, choose Create household, and select a currency. Your Drive will own the household sheet. Invite your partner from Members. They can sign in on their phone and choose Join shared household to select your ledger.
